title: Attach lineage and test results when promoting a recipe version
narrative: New recipe versions must be immutable artifacts with provenance, lineage, test results, and a reversible promotion pointer. Research and rule promotion patterns exist (`taloneth_insp_rule_promotion`) but the recipe catalog still overwrites by name. Tracks MH-SR-05[^insp-sr-05].
implementation: Stamp provenance on templates; ResearchLab promote/rollback; rule_promotion. Desired: recipe lineage DAG, eval attachments, and pointer-based promote/rollback.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-SR-05, coverage partial, adjacent_ok true.
